description.narrative: The project will aim at the Standards Agencies in the East African Trade Networks enabling them to exchange data on goods moving across borders to facilitate efficient border and market compliance and surveillance. With the agencies being at different levels of automation and adoption of ICT in their operations, the agencies have built collaboration frameworks in support of intra-regional trade through the East Africa Community (EAC) Secretariat. This project will go a long way to enhance the efforts already put in place.
